settlement_source: Official result per governing league (PGA Tour); Source Agencies per ACHIEVEMENTS terms: league, AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports
settlement_variable: Whether the named golfer is the first reported official final winner of the tournament (also other market types: finishing position, make cut, H2H, 3-ball, round leader)
tie_handling: Multiple participants reported as winner -> each Yes pays $1/N rounded down to the cent, No gets $1-Yes. Playoff handling not explicit (unknown)
rounding: Share split rounded down to nearest cent
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading time = expiration time (10:00 AM ET, latest day after official final result); sample close_time == expiration_time 2026-11-15T00:00Z; settlement_timer_seconds 60
early_close_or_void_clauses: Final round postponed: open until result or 2 weeks after scheduled date. Suspended: up to 2 years. Cancelled/no result: Yes holders get last traded price (or Outcome Review Committee allocation, else $1/N eligible). Withdraw/forfeit/DQ/eliminated -> No (Winner, Round Leader); Finishing Position/Cut/H2H/3-ball -> Fair Market Value. Shortened event with official result stands. Post-expiration revisions ignored. Sole-discretion outcome review. can_close_early=1.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title X wins omits that pre-tee withdrawal resolves No for winner markets but Fair Market Value for other market types (discretionary)
First official final result: DQ before expiry flips to No/next player; later DQ ignored
Cancellation payout is last-traded price, not binary
toxicity_flags: Outcome is publicly determined on-course well before Kalshi expiration; leaderboard lag vs book updates creates adverse selection for slow quoting
Final-round leader late in round near-deterministic; stale asks get picked off
Long-dated (3-week) markets with many thin longshot strikes
Fair-Market-Value / last-traded-price discretionary payouts on withdrawals and cancellations
Insider prohibition list (players, staff, league); MNPI exists on withdrawals/injuries
Playoff/weather suspensions up to 2 years lock capital
notes: Series covers weekly tournaments (e.g. VidantaWorld Mexico Open) as events; terms are generic ACHIEVEMENTS pdf. Playoff handling unknown. Feed latencies not measured.
